principles.name: Open Files
principles.description: Rook activity on files with no pawns.

principles.name: Outposts
principles.description: Advanced knights on squares not chased by enemy pawns.

principles.name: Bishop Pair
principles.description: Two bishops on opposite colors vs. opponent with one bishop.

principles.name: Passed Pawn
principles.description: Pawn with no enemy pawns ahead on adjacent files.

principles.name: Rook Behind Passed Pawn
principles.description: Rook behind its own passed pawn.

principles.name: Space Advantage
principles.description: More controlled squares in the opponent's half (attacked squares beyond the midline).

principles.name: Isolated Pawn
principles.description: Pawn with no friendly pawns on adjacent files.

principles.name: Backward Pawn
principles.description: Pawn that cannot be supported by adjacent pawns and has its forward square controlled by enemy pawns.

principles.name: Doubled Pawns
principles.description: Two or more pawns of the same color on the same file.

principles.name: Material Advantage
principles.description: One side has more material (piece value) than the other; lists captured opposing pieces responsible for the lead.

principles.name: Attacked Pieces
principles.description: Pieces of the side to move that are currently attacked by the opponent who just moved; red arrows from attacker to each attacked piece.

principles.name: King Check
principles.description: Detects when the side to move is in check; highlights the king square and shows attackers.

principles.name: Checkmate
principles.description: Detects when the side to move is checkmated; highlights the king square and shows final attacking lines.

principles.name: Tactics
principles.description: Immediate tactical opportunities (mate-in-1, checks, hanging captures) for the side to move.
